value.residual: The canonical versioned authority path has retained InMemory tests for exact Relation artifact identity, exact active Relation/Entity pins, endpoint object kinds, existing and same-commit cardinality conflicts, superseded versions, atomic rejection, and immutable-id payload updates; its Turso/reopen variants were removed in #2764 (not currently covered). Quint checks a two-relation abstraction across all four declared cardinalities, exact accepted-version binding, exact endpoint-kind admission, and rejected no-ops; Lean proves compact pairwise reference lemmas. Neither artifact is Rust refinement evidence, a future parallel writer topology must add relation-kind/index-level serialization, and the legacy unversioned migration path remains non-authoritative until disabled. Public scope excludes the former engine/provider implementation and its evidence; no correspondence is claimed for that omitted code.
